text:
Congratulations to Ailbhe McNamara, a final-year BSc Biomedical & Molecular Diagnostics student at TU Dublin, who carried out her undergraduate thesis project in our lab. Her project, “Development of a Multiplex PCR Assay Targeting Virulence and Mobile Genetic Element-Associated Markers in Enterococcus faecium”, was supervised by Dr Peter Kinnevey and Emma Moore, with support from Dr Abed Alkarem Abu Al Haija.

Ailbhe has been awarded the medal for Highest Achieving Final Year Student 2025–26 and the Deciphex Medal for Best Overall Project 2025–26. Well done, Ailbhe! 🎉
New paper in Microbiology: a single α-TLO gene is enough to restore full virulence to C. albicans strains depleted of the TLO family.
New paper in PLoS ONE: deleting the TLO gene family alters membrane sterols and fluconazole tolerance in C. albicans.
New paper in PLoS Genetics: CRISPR-Cas9 deletion of the whole TLO family reveals distinct roles for the α, β and γ clades.
